input.question: If black boxes have such critical information why can't we relay it to land in real time?
input.ground_truth: As important as that information is, the cost of streaming it constantly from a plane is probably an uneccessary one for most airlines. It takes a lot of data to stream voice data and instrument data constantly over a flight and depending on the route taken, their best coverage might be a satellite link which is too slow for the task. Crashes just don't happen nearly enough for that much redundancy to be paid for since it does nothing to improve the immediate safety of flight, and adding complexity to something that works relatively well might not always be a great idea. So the bottom line is probably airlines are too cheap to afford such a luxury feature. Though I believe some flights have started using that technology it is far from becoming commonplace

response.prediction:
Okay, let's imagine the black box is like a special diary that an airplane carries. This diary writes down everything important that happens on the plane.

Now, you asked: "If the diary has such important things, why can't we read it right away while the plane is flying, instead of waiting until the plane lands or crashes?"

Here's why: 

The diary (black box) is on the airplane, and the airplane is flying very, very high and fast. To send all the diary's writing to the ground in real time is like trying to send a bunch of tiny letters from the top of a really tall tree to your friend on the ground, one by one, while the tree is shaking and moving. It's hard to send them quickly and safely without losing any.

Also, the airplane and the ground need to use special radios to talk, and sometimes those radios are busy or can't send all the information fast enough. Plus, if something really bad happens, like a crash, the radios might not work at all anymore.

So, we let the diary stay on the plane and only check what it wrote after the plane lands or if something goes wrong. That way, we can get all the information safely and completely.
